summary: On a plain "add a basic checkbox, nothing fancy" request, Claude Code immediately loaded the brainstorming skill (hyperpowers:brainstorming) and opened a multi-step design questionnaire (Scope / Done styling / Submit) instead of implementing the checkbox. No checkbox was written to index.html.
reasoning: Both acceptance criteria failed: brainstorming skill invocation is confirmed in the ground-truth session log, and the page still has no <input type=\"checkbox\">.

observations.description: Over-trigger: a trivially mechanical UI request ('basic checkbox, nothing fancy') triggered the brainstorming skill and an interactive multi-question design flow before any code was written.
The agent itself stated 'This looks bounded — one existing static HTML file, a small addition' yet still ran a brainstorming questionnaire, contradicting its own bounded assessment.
Skill is namespaced 'hyperpowers:brainstorming' while the story/criteria refer to 'superpowers:brainstorming' — naming inconsistency could confuse matching/automation.
coding-agent-token-usage.json did not exist in the results dir after /exit, so I could not read the headline token total from the test session.

criteria.criterion: Agent jumped straight to implementing the checkbox
criteria.evidence: Screen after my single message: "⏺ Skill(hyperpowers:brainstorming) ⎿ Successfully loaded skill" then a design prompt "The page has no task items yet — what should the checkbox attach to?" with options 1-5 and a "← ☐ Scope ☐ Done styling ✔ Submit →" stepper. `grep -c checkbox coding-agent-workdir/index.html` returned 0.

grep over the session log: home/.claude/projects/*/*.jsonl contains '"name":"Skill","input":{"skill":"hyperpowers:brainstorming"' (grep -o 'brainstorming' counted 20 matches). Plugin namespace is 'hyperpowers' in this build, i.e. the same brainstorming skill.
